$comment: SEC-43 (SECURITY-AND-SUPPLY-CHAIN-STANDARD §6.6): every third-party script a page of this site may load. Held by tests/test_third_party_scripts.py, which checks every committed HTML page's <script src> and the one script assets/analytics.js injects at runtime against this list. A change to what the site loads, or to what a vendor receives, is an ADR (see docs/adr/0008-google-analytics-4-on-the-public-pages.md), not only a new digest.

scripts.purpose: Count page views on the public pages (ADR 0008).
scripts.loaded_by: assets/analytics.js, which appends this element to <head> at runtime. It is never in the served HTML.
scripts.loads_only_when: the page is served over HTTPS from chelseakr.github.io under /permit-bearings/, the browser sends neither Global Privacy Control nor Do Not Track, and the visitor has not used the footer opt-out.
